title: Record a video room
summary: record_on_start true on a room makes the platform record each of its sessions. A session's recordings list over REST, each with a uri, a status and a duration, and a DELETE by recording id removes one.
scenario: A workshop stand-up on video that the people who missed it watch later

evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/video/rooms record_on_start: 'Specifies whether to start recording a Room Session when one is started for this Room.'
tools/openapi/rest.json GET /api/video/room_sessions/{id}/recordings, GET/DELETE /api/video/room_recordings/{id}: id, room_session_id, status, duration, format, uri; 204
Browser SDK v4 reference labels startRecording unimplemented (sol round 5)
